description: Calculate the d-band center of a single Pt atom substituting one surface Ni atom on the Ni(111) ferromagnetic surface.
user_prompt: Build a Ni(111) surface slab (FCC, Fm-3m) and substitute one surface Ni atom with a single Pt atom. Extract the d-band center (in eV relative to the Fermi level) from the Pt atom's d-orbital projected DOS and report the final value.
